poe.notes: J9772A. QuickSpecs p.12 electrical table: 'PoE power 382 W' and it defines 'PoE power is the total power budget available to all PoE ports' (max power rating 476 W, idle 40.1 W).

J9729A. HPE spec table lists 'PoE power 370 W' for the 2920-48G-PoE+ column (max power rating 475/487 W, idle 42/46 W). Caution: the separate '2920-48G-PoE+ 740W' SKU J9836A is 740 W and an X332 1050 W PSU raises the budget - this row is the default-PSU 370 W figure.
GSM4212P. Official product spec: 'PoE Ports / Budget: 8 PoE+ (30W/port), 125W Budget'; with-PoE consumption 163.9 W confirms 125 W is the PD allocation, not the PSU.
GSM4230P. Official product spec: 'PoE Ports / Budget: 24 PoE+ (30W/port), 300W Budget'; M4250 datasheet repeats 'total PoE budget of 300W to be shared among all ports'. With-PoE consumption 401 W.

techspecs 'Total PoE Availability' is input-dependent: 196W with the optional 210W AC adapter, 76W on PoE+++ input, 46W on PoE++ input, 16W on PoE+ input. 196 W recorded (AC-powered case); model the lower figures when it is itself PoE-fed.
techspecs 'Total PoE Availability 52W'; 4 PoE+ ports, 60W external adapter, 60W max including PoE output.
techspecs 'Total PoE Availability 120W'; 8 PoE+ ports at 32W/port PSE, 150W internal PSU, 150W max including PoE output (30W switch draw).
techspecs 'Total PoE Availability 400W'; 24 PoE+ ports at 32W/port PSE, 550W internal PSU, 460W max including PoE output.
techspecs 'Total PoE Availability 400W'; 16 PoE+ / 8 PoE++ ports, 450W internal PSU, 450W max including PoE output (50W switch draw).

techspecs 'Total PoE Availability 600W'; 40 PoE+ / 8 PoE++ ports, 660W internal PSU, 660W max including PoE output (60W switch draw). Fixes the existing audit gap where this model had no modelled budget.
techspecs 'Total PoE Availability 180W'; 12 PoE+ / 4 PoE++ ports, 210W external AC adapter, 210W max including PoE output.
techspecs 'Total PoE Availability 720W'; 32 PoE+ / 16 PoE++ ports, 870W internal PSU, 820W max including PoE output (100W switch draw).
